history.summary: 936 sqft 3BR at Parkwood Residences — web research confirms this is a tiny 18-UNIT boutique freehold-style development (99yr from 2018) on Yio Chu Kang Road, TOP 2023. Priced at $1,667 psf with new-launch bias flagged and only 17 URA txns; the future Serangoon North CRL station (580m) is the one upside.
history.rating_rationale: An 18-unit development is structurally illiquid — no resale depth, no facilities scale, and exit depends entirely on finding one of very few comparable buyers. New-launch bias is flagged and only 17 txns exist, so the implied pricing is developer-set and unproven on resale. At $1,667 psf in OCR D19 this is rich for a boutique with no amenities. The future CRL station is real but does not rescue a fundamentally illiquid micro-development for a 5-7yr investment exit.

$1,667 psf rich for an amenity-light OCR boutique
No meaningful URA median to anchor value
